app_name: Prop Firm Risk Matrix & Strategy Simulator
personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK fused with 7 Dark-First Utility density
personality_one_liner: A premium, quantitative hedge-fund aesthetic balancing high-density data visibility with cinematic dark-mode glassmorphism.

spacing.rule: Use tight, utility-focused spacing to maximize data density while preserving tap targets. Cards use `md` padding; data rows use `sm`.

do's: Apply to sticky headers, bottom tab bar, and bottom sheet headers
Apply to the floating 'Run Sim' / 'Control Panel' action buttons
Use 75%+ opacity #1E1E24 tint underneath blur to guarantee data readability
dont's: Never apply to dense data tables, heatmaps, or charts
Do not use on standard list rows or KPI cards (use solid #1E1E24)

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: High-level command center showing aggregated KPIs (Pass Probability, Expected ROI, Drawdown).

states.loading: Skeleton grids mapping to the KPI card layout.
states.empty: Prompt user to 'Configure Strategy Parameters' to see KPIs.
states.error: Failed to calculate simulation; Retry button.

screens.layout: Top section: 2-column grid of essential KPI cards (Pass Probability, Profit Factor). Middle: Condensed mini-chart of expected equity. Bottom sticky floating CTA: 'Control Panel' (opens bottom sheet for inputs).

screens.name: Matrices
screens.purpose: Interactive heatmaps showing Pass Probability and ROI across Risk % and RR ratios.

states.empty: Provide a placeholder heatmap with muted colors until parameters are set.

screens.layout: Top: Segmented control to toggle between 'Pass Probability' and 'ROI Matrix'. Middle: ScrollView with pinch-to-zoom containing the 8x16 heatmap. Cells colored dynamically (Red 0-35%, Amber 36-64%, Green 65-100%). Bottom: Tap a cell to open a detail bottom sheet.

screens.name: Simulator
screens.purpose: Monte Carlo and Drawdown analytics visualizer.

states.loading: Spinner over an empty axis chart.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll. 1. Monte Carlo Equity Curve chart (20 paths + 95% band). 2. Drawdown Analysis scatter/line chart. 3. Drawdown Recovery bar chart. Use 'react-native-gifted-charts' with dark-themed gridlines (#2A2A35) and neon/cyan/green line strokes.

screens.name: Tools
screens.purpose: Access point for Strategy Analyzer, Optimizer, Account Comparison, and Settings.
screens.layout: List layout of cards for 'Strategy Analyzer', 'Optimizer', 'Account Comparison', and 'Settings'. Clicking a card pushes a stack screen. Account Comparison uses a horizontal scrollable table.

screens.name: Control Panel (Bottom Sheet)
screens.purpose: The main input surface for all numeric and toggle variables.
screens.layout: Full-screen or 90% snap point Bottom Sheet. Categorized single-column form: Account Params, Strategy Params, Simulation Rules. Features a sticky 'Run Simulation' primary CTA at the bottom.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the user's color palette: Background #121212, Cards #1E1E24, Panels #252530, Success #00FF88, Warning #FFD54F, Danger #FF5252, Text #FFFFFF, Muted #B8BCC8.
Use JetBrains Mono for all heatmap data cells, numeric KPIs, and chart axes to ensure tabular alignment.

Heatmap Construction: A 8x16 grid will overflow standard mobile screens. Wrap it in a horizontal and vertical ScrollView to allow panning. Color logic must strictly follow user thresholds: 0-35% (#FF5252), 36-64% (#FFD54F), 65-100% (#00FF88).

Charts: For `react-native-gifted-charts`, style axes and grid lines with `#2A2A35` (border color) to prevent them from overpowering the data. The 95% confidence band should use a translucent fill under the main path.
Input Layout: Since there are many variables (Account Size, Win Rate, DD, Consistency, etc.), group them logically inside the Control Panel bottom sheet, using toggles and native numeric inputs.
Apply Glassmorphism cautiously: the Control Panel bottom sheet and bottom tab bar should use `expo-blur` layered over `surfaceSecondary` with 80% opacity to preserve background contrast.
Do NOT use standard blue/purple anywhere. The brand primary is a matte `#FFFFFF` (Linear-style design), allowing the neon Red/Amber/Green metrics to draw all the visual attention.
